title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: TableRelation
summary: This blog series explores the TableRelation property in Business Central, covering how it differs from Enum/Option and Lookup fields on pages, how to extend it through table extensions, validation rules for primary keys, permission requirements, and methods to query table relationships programmatically.
key_points: TableRelation defines field-level data validation by linking fields to specific tables and their key fields
TableRelation differs from Enum/Option and Lookup controls in how they appear and function on page interfaces
Extending TableRelation through table extensions requires careful consideration of primary key constraints
Users without permission to read the related table may encounter access restrictions when using TableRelation fields
The Record.Relation method allows developers to determine and query table relationships programmatically
